templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 长方形面积
templates.stem: 一个长方形花坛，长 {a} 厘米，宽 {b} 厘米。它的面积是多少？
templates.solution: 长方形面积 ＝ 长 × 宽 ＝ {a} × {b} ＝ {a*b}（平方厘米）。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三角形面积
templates.stem: 一个三角形的底是 {a} 厘米，这条底边上的高是 {h} 厘米。它的面积是多少？
templates.solution: 三角形面积 ＝ 底 × 高 ÷ 2 ＝ {a} × {h} ÷ 2 ＝ {a*h/2}（平方厘米）。

templates.stem: 甲乙两地相距 {a} 千米。一辆汽车每小时行驶 {b} 千米，从甲地到乙地需要多少小时？
templates.solution: 时间 ＝ 路程 ÷ 速度 ＝ {a} ÷ {b} ＝ {a/b}（小时）。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 单价×数量＝总价
templates.stem: 一支钢笔 {a} 元，买 {b} 支一共需要多少元？
templates.solution: 总价 ＝ 单价 × 数量 ＝ {a} × {b} ＝ {a*b}（元）。

templates.title: 求三个数的平均数
templates.stem: 小明三次数学测验的成绩分别是 {a} 分、{b} 分和 {c} 分。这三次的平均成绩是多少分？

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 鸡兔同笼求兔数
templates.stem: 鸡和兔关在同一个笼子里，从上面数一共有 {h} 个头，从下面数一共有 {f} 只脚。兔子有多少只？
templates.solution: 假设全是鸡，应有 {2*h} 只脚；实际多出 {f} − {2*h} ＝ {f-2*h} 只脚。每把一只鸡换成一只兔会多 2 只脚，所以兔有 {f-2*h} ÷ 2 ＝ {(f-2*h)/2} 只。

stem.en: How many flowers are in the vase? (see original picture)
stem.zh: 花瓶里一共有多少朵花？（见原题图）

solution.en: Count the flowers one by one: there are 7 flowers in the vase.
solution.zh: 一朵一朵指着数：花瓶里一共有 7 朵花。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 一定会发生／可能发生／一定不会发生

stem.en: Today is Monday 6 June, and it is sunny. Which of these statements tells something that WILL happen?
stem.zh: 今天是 6 月 6 日，星期一，天气晴。下面哪一句说的是「一定」会发生的事？

options.zh: 下星期一将是 6 月 13 日

solution.en: Tomorrow is Tuesday, not Thursday — will NOT happen. Today is Monday; 7 days later is next Monday, 6+7=13, so next Monday WILL be 13 June. Whether it is sunny tomorrow is yet to be seen — it MIGHT happen.
solution.zh: 明天是星期二，不是星期四——一定不会发生；今天星期一，过 7 天正好是下星期一，6＋7＝13，所以下星期一一定是 6 月 13 日——一定会发生；明天晴不晴要等到才知道——只是可能发生。

stem.en: Jess made shapes with sticks: shape 1 used {a} sticks, shape 2 used {a+d}, shape 3 used {a+2*d}. Following the pattern, how many sticks are needed for shape {n}?
stem.zh: 杰丝用小棒搭图形：图形 1 用了 {a} 根小棒，图形 2 用了 {a+d} 根，图形 3 用了 {a+2*d} 根。照这个规律，搭图形 {n} 要用多少根小棒？

solution.en: Each next shape uses {d} more sticks: shape 1 is {a}, shape 2 is {a+d}, shape 3 is {a+2*d}… shape {n} is {n-1} steps after shape 1, so {a}＋{d}×{n-1}＝{a+(n-1)*d} sticks.
solution.zh: 每往后一个图形多用 {d} 根：图形 1 用 {a} 根，图形 2 用 {a+d} 根，图形 3 用 {a+2*d} 根……图形 {n} 比图形 1 多（{n}-1）＝{n-1} 次，所以是 {a}＋{d}×{n-1}＝{a+(n-1)*d} 根。

stem.en: Max was drawing a hexagon and had drawn {k} sides. How many more sides does he need to draw to finish it?
stem.zh: 马克在画一个六边形，已经画了 {k} 条边。他还要再画几条边才能画完这个六边形？

solution.en: A hexagon has 6 sides. {k} are drawn, so {6-k} more are needed.
solution.zh: 六边形有 6 条边。已经画了 {k} 条，还缺 6−{k}＝{6-k} 条。

stem.en: Liz made a two-digit number with the digit cards 2, 3, 4, 6, 9: the ones digit is {d} more than the tens digit. What is the number?
stem.zh: 莉兹用数字卡片 2、3、4、6、9 摆了一个两位数：个位数字比十位数字大 {d}。她摆的两位数是多少？

solution.en: The tens digit is {t}; the ones digit is {d} more, so {t}＋{d}＝{u}. The two-digit number is {10*t+u}.
solution.zh: 十位是 {t}，个位比它大 {d}，个位是 {t}＋{d}＝{u}。这个两位数是 {10*t+u}。

stem.en: Look at the picture of the house (see original picture): square windows, rectangular door and walls, round doorknob. Which shape was NOT used in the picture?
stem.zh: 看这幅房子的画（见原题图）：正方形的窗户、长方形的门和墙、圆形的门把手。哪种形状在画里「没有」用到？

solution.en: The picture has squares (windows), rectangles (door, walls) and circles (doorknob) — but no triangle.
solution.zh: 画里有正方形（窗户）、长方形（门、墙）、圆形（门把手），唯独没有三角形。

stem.en: On the number line, the distance from 0 to {E} is divided into {n} equal parts. The arrow points at the {k}th mark from 0. What number is shown at the arrow?
stem.zh: 一条数轴上，0 到 {E} 之间被平均分成了 {n} 小格。箭头指在从 0 数起的第 {k} 格刻度上，这个刻度表示多少？

solution.en: Each part is {E}÷{n}＝{E/n}. The {k}th mark is {k}×{E/n}＝{k*E/n}.
solution.zh: 每小格表示 {E}÷{n}＝{E/n}。第 {k} 格就是 {k}×{E/n}＝{k*E/n}。

stem.en: Jack received four present boxes (see original picture). When he opens the largest, longest thin box, what would he most likely find inside?
stem.zh: 杰克收到四个礼物盒（见原题图）。打开「最大的那个细长盒子」时，他最可能找到什么？

solution.en: A skateboard is long and flat, so it fits the largest thin box; a ball goes in a tall box, a watch in the smallest box, shoes in a medium-large box.
solution.zh: 滑板又长又扁，适合装在最大的细长盒子里；篮球装高盒子、手表装最小的盒子、鞋子装中等偏大的盒子。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 象形统计图：比某队恰好多 2 球

stem.en: Goals scored by four teams last match: Team A {a}, Team B {b}, Team C {c}, Team D {dd}. Which team scored exactly 2 more goals than Team C?
stem.zh: 四支球队最近一场比赛的进球数：甲队 {a} 球，乙队 {b} 球，丙队 {c} 球，丁队 {dd} 球。哪队进的球正好比丙队多 2 球？

solution.en: Team C scored {c}; 2 more is {c+2} — that is exactly Team A ({a}). Team B {b} and Team D {dd} are wrong.
solution.zh: 丙队进 {c} 球，多 2 球就是 {c+2} 球——正好是甲队（{a} 球）。乙队 {b} 球、丁队 {dd} 球都不对。

solution.en: Replace each symbol with its number: {a}＋{b}−{c}＝{a+b-c}.
solution.zh: 把每个符号换成它的数：{a}＋{b}−{c}＝{a+b-c}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 选出三张和为定值的卡片（多选）

stem.en: Choose THREE cards so that the three numbers add to exactly {T}. (Select three cards)
stem.zh: 从下面五张卡片中选出「三张」，使三张卡片上的数加起来正好是 {T}。（点选三张卡片）

solution.en: The correct three cards are {v1}, {v3}, {v4}: {v1}＋{v3}＋{v4}＝{T}. No other three cards add to {T}.
solution.zh: 三张正确的卡片是 {v1}、{v3}、{v4}：{v1}＋{v3}＋{v4}＝{T}。其他任何三张的和都不等于 {T}。

stem.en: It is exactly 12 o'clock now. Which clock shows a time half an hour LATER?
stem.zh: 现在是 12 点整。哪个钟显示的时间比现在「快半小时」？

solution.en: "Half an hour later" means 30 minutes after 12, which is 12:30.
solution.zh: 「快半小时」就是多走半小时：12 点再过半小时是 12:30。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 电梯上上下下（出到地上楼层）

stem.en: Cara got into a lift at level B{b} below ground. She went up {u} levels and down {d} levels, then got out. What level ABOVE ground did she get out at? (B1 is one level below ground; G is ground level; above-ground floors count from 1.)
stem.zh: 卡拉在地下 B{b} 层进了电梯。电梯上升了 {u} 层，又下降了 {d} 层，她出了电梯。她是在地上几楼出的电梯？（B1 是地下 1 层，G 是地面层，地上从 1 楼数起）

solution.en: B{b} is level −{b}: −{b}＋{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}, so she got out at level {0-b+u-d} above ground.
solution.zh: B{b} 相当于 −{b} 层：−{b}＋{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}，所以她在 {0-b+u-d} 楼出电梯。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 电梯上上下下（出到地下楼层）

stem.en: Cara got into a lift at level B{b} below ground. She went up {u} levels and down {d} levels, then got out. What level BELOW ground (B?) did she get out at? (B1 is one level below ground.)
stem.zh: 卡拉在地下 B{b} 层进了电梯。电梯上升了 {u} 层，又下降了 {d} 层，她出了电梯。她是在地下哪一层出的电梯？（B1 是地下 1 层）

solution.en: B{b} is level −{b}: −{b}＋{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}; a negative result means below ground, i.e. level B{0-(0-b+u-d)}.
solution.zh: B{b} 相当于 −{b} 层：−{b}＋{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}，负数表示在地下，就是 B{0-(0-b+u-d)} 层。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数一数两种车一共有几辆

stem.en: Mary counted vehicles at a bus stop: {a} cars, {b} bikes, {c} trucks, {dd} buses. How many cars and trucks were there altogether?
stem.zh: 玛丽在公交站数车：小汽车 {a} 辆，自行车 {b} 辆，卡车 {c} 辆，公交车 {dd} 辆。她看到的小汽车和卡车一共有多少辆？

solution.en: Only add the cars and trucks: {a}＋{c}＝{a+c} (bikes and buses are distractors).
solution.zh: 只要把小汽车和卡车加起来：{a}＋{c}＝{a+c} 辆（自行车和公交车是干扰信息）。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 吃一半再吃一半，还剩几颗

stem.en: Kurt picked some strawberries. He ate half on Friday and half of what was left on Saturday, leaving {L}. How many strawberries did he pick altogether?
stem.zh: 库尔特摘了一些草莓。他周五吃掉了一半，周六又吃掉了剩下的一半，最后还剩 {L} 颗。库尔特一共摘了多少颗草莓？

solution.en: Work backwards: {L} left means before Saturday there were {L}×2＝{2*L}; before Friday there were {2*L}×2＝{4*L}. He picked {4*L} in all.
solution.zh: 倒着推：剩下 {L} 颗，说明周六吃之前有 {L}×2＝{2*L} 颗；周五吃之前有 {2*L}×2＝{4*L} 颗。一共摘了 {4*L} 颗。

stem.en: Look at the bookshelf (see original picture). Sara's favourite book is on the second shelf from the top and the third from the right. Which description is it?
stem.zh: 看书架图（见原题图）。萨拉最喜欢的书在「从上数第二层、从右数第三本」。这本书的位置是下面哪一句？

options.en: the second book from the left on the top shelf
the third book from the right on the second shelf
the first book from the left on the third shelf
the second book from the right on the bottom shelf

solution.en: Find the second shelf from the top, then count three books from the right — that is Sara's favourite book.
solution.zh: 先找到从上数第二层，再从右边往左数第三本，就是萨拉最喜欢的书。

stem.en: A stick is divided into {k} equal segments, coloured red and white (see the diagram below). What is half of the stick in segments?
stem.zh: 一根小棍被平均分成了 {k} 小段，涂成红白相间（如下图）。这根小棍的一半是多少小段？

solution.en: Half means split the {k} segments into two equal parts: {k}÷2＝{k/2} segments.
solution.zh: 一半就是把 {k} 段平均分成两份：{k}÷2＝{k/2} 段。

stem.en: Four children count backwards in turn from {S}: A says “{S}”, B says “{S-1}”, C says “{S-2}”, D says “{S-3}”, then back to A… Following this, who says “{n}”?
stem.zh: 四个小伙伴轮流从 {S} 往下倒数：甲先说“{S}”，乙接着说“{S-1}”，丙说“{S-2}”，丁说“{S-3}”，然后又轮到甲……照这样数下去，“{n}”会轮到谁说？

solution.en: From {S} to {n} is {S-n} numbers; with 4 children per round, {S-n}÷4 divides exactly (remainder 0), so it comes back to the first speaker — A.
solution.zh: 从 {S} 数到 {n} 一共数了 {S-n} 个数，4 人一轮，{S-n}÷4 正好除尽（余 0），说明又轮回到第 1 个人——甲。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 正方形围栏要多少根柱子

stem.en: A farmer wants a square paddock. He puts {p} posts on each side, with one post at each corner (corner posts are shared by two sides). How many posts does he need in total?
stem.zh: 农场主要围一块正方形的地。每条边上立 {p} 根柱子，四个角各有一根（角上的柱子两条边共用）。他一共要用多少根柱子？

solution.en: Simply 4×{p}＝{4*p} would count each corner post twice, so subtract 4. Total = 4×{p}−4＝{4*p-4} posts.
solution.zh: 如果直接 4×{p}＝{4*p}，四个角的柱子就被数了两次，要多减去 4。所以一共 4×{p}−4＝{4*p-4} 根。

stem.en: Abdi has {a} marbles. Jenny has {m} more than Abdi. Peter has {k} fewer than Jenny. How many marbles do the three have altogether?
stem.zh: 阿布迪有 {a} 颗弹珠。珍妮比阿布迪多 {m} 颗，彼得比珍妮少 {k} 颗。他们三人一共有多少颗弹珠？

solution.en: Jenny has {a}＋{m}＝{a+m}; Peter has {a+m}−{k}＝{a+m-k}. Total = {a}＋{a+m}＋{a+m-k}＝{3*a+2*m-k}.
solution.zh: 珍妮有 {a}＋{m}＝{a+m} 颗，彼得有 {a+m}−{k}＝{a+m-k} 颗。一共 {a}＋{a+m}＋{a+m-k}＝{3*a+2*m-k} 颗。

stem.en: Jamie hangs lanterns in the repeating order red, yellow, blue, green. What colour is the {n}th lantern?
stem.zh: 杰米挂灯笼，按「红、黄、蓝、绿」的顺序不断重复。第 {n} 个灯笼是什么颜色？

solution.en: 4 lanterns make one group. {n}÷4＝{n/4} groups with remainder 1; remainder 1 is the first in each group — red.
solution.zh: 4 个灯笼为一组。{n}÷4＝{n/4} 组余 1，余 1 就是每组里的第 1 个——红色。

stem.en: Sydney has four seasons: spring is in September, October, November. Darwin has two seasons: the wet season is from November to April (see original wheel charts). Which month is spring in Sydney AND the wet season in Darwin?
stem.zh: 悉尼一年有四季：春天是 9、10、11 月。达尔文只有两季：雨季是 11 月到次年 4 月（见原题圆盘图）。哪一个月悉尼是春天、达尔文正好是雨季？

solution.en: Sydney's spring is Sep–Nov; Darwin's wet season is Nov–Apr. Only November is in both.
solution.zh: 悉尼的春天是 9—11 月；达尔文的雨季是 11—4 月。两个月里只有 11 月同时满足。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 用尽可能多的硬币付款

stem.en: Anna has 14 coins in her purse (denominations shown in the original picture). She buys a 50c lollipop and a 95c chocolate bar, totalling 145c. She pays exactly and uses AS MANY COINS AS POSSIBLE. How many coins did she use?
stem.zh: 安娜的钱包里有 14 枚硬币（面值见原题图）。她要买 50 分的棒棒糖和 95 分的巧克力棒，一共 145 分。她要正好付清，并且「用尽可能多的硬币」。她用了多少枚硬币？

solution.en: The total is 145c. To use the MOST coins, use as many small values as possible; with the 5c, 10c, 20c and 50c coins in the purse, 145c can be made with at most 10 coins.
solution.zh: 一共 145 分。想用最多的硬币，就尽量用小面值：钱包里的 5 分、10 分、20 分、50 分硬币凑出 145 分，最多能用到 10 枚。

stem.en: Ben's table top is tiled in a blue/yellow checker pattern (see original picture); a 4×4 patch is missing in the dashed box. What should the missing patch look like?
stem.zh: 本在桌面铺蓝黄相间的方砖（见原题图），虚线框处缺了一块 4×4 的补块。补块应该是什么样子的？

options.en: the patch with a yellow square in row 2, column 2
options.zh: 第二行第二格是黄色的补块

options.en: the patch with a blue square in row 2, column 2
options.zh: 第二行第二格是蓝色的补块

options.en: the patch with a yellow square in row 1, column 2
options.zh: 第一行第二格是黄色的补块

options.en: the patch with a yellow square in row 3, column 3
options.zh: 第三行第三格是黄色的补块

solution.en: Line the missing patch up with the rows and columns of the table; the completed pattern has a yellow square at row 2, column 2 of the patch.
solution.zh: 按桌面花纹的行列对齐去接，缺的那一块接上后第二行第二格应该是黄色。

stem.en: Bobby has three rectangular sheets: the yellow sheet is {m} times the red sheet, and the red sheet is {k} times the blue sheet. How many blue sheets exactly cover one yellow sheet?
stem.zh: 鲍比有三张长方形纸：黄纸是红纸的 {m} 倍大，红纸是蓝纸的 {k} 倍大。一张黄纸能正好铺满多少张蓝纸？

solution.en: Yellow = {m} red sheets = {m}×{k} blue sheets, so one yellow sheet covers exactly {m*k} blue sheets.
solution.zh: 黄纸＝{m} 张红纸＝{m}×{k} 张蓝纸，所以一张黄纸正好铺 {m*k} 张蓝纸。

stem.en: Sita's counter is on a black square of a black-and-white board (see original picture). She moves it 1 square left and 2 squares forward toward Mark. On which square does it land?
stem.zh: 西塔的棋子在黑白棋盘的黑格上（见原题图）。她把棋子往左移 1 格，又朝马克的方向前移 2 格。棋子最后停在哪一格？

options.en: the white square on the far right of the second-last row
options.zh: 倒数第二行最右边的白格

options.en: the second square from the left on the second-last row
options.zh: 倒数第二行左起第二格

options.en: the first square from the left on the third row
the middle white square on the bottom row

solution.en: From Sita's square, 1 left and then 2 toward Mark (downwards) lands exactly on the white square at the far right of the second-last row.
solution.zh: 从西塔的位置往左 1 格、再向马克（往下）2 格，正好落在倒数第二行最右边的白格上。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 池塘边的鸟：飞来又飞走

stem.en: There were {s} birds on the pond. Tina records every 5 minutes: at 5 min {a1} fly in, {f1} fly away; at 10 min {a2} in, {f2} away; at 15 min {a3} in, {f3} away; at 20 min {a4} in, {f4} away. How many birds are on the pond after 20 minutes?
stem.zh: 池塘里原有 {s} 只鸟。蒂娜每 5 分钟记一次：第 5 分钟飞来 {a1} 只、飞走 {f1} 只；第 10 分钟飞来 {a2} 只、飞走 {f2} 只；第 15 分钟飞来 {a3} 只、飞走 {f3} 只；第 20 分钟飞来 {a4} 只、飞走 {f4} 只。20 分钟后池塘里有多少只鸟？

solution.en: Add each change in turn: {s}＋{a1}−{f1}＋{a2}−{f2}＋{a3}−{f3}＋{a4}−{f4}＝{T} birds.

stem.en: Gina has {n} differently coloured blocks (yellow, blue, green, pink…). She builds an {n}-level tower with the green block fixed at the bottom. How many DIFFERENT towers can she build?
stem.zh: 吉娜有 {n} 块颜色不同的积木（黄、蓝、绿、粉……），想搭一座 {n} 层的高塔，其中绿积木必须在最底层。她能搭出多少座不一样的塔？

solution.en: Green is fixed at the bottom; the remaining {n-1} blocks go on top: {n-1} choices for level 2, {n-2} for level 3, {n-3} for level 4… = {(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)} towers.
solution.zh: 绿积木固定在最底层不用动，剩下的 {n-1} 块排上面：第 2 层有 {n-1} 种选法，第 3 层剩 {n-2} 种，第 4 层剩 {n-3} 种……一共 {(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)} 座。

stem.en: ◆＋▲＋●＝ {A}; ▲＋▲＋●＋●＝ {B}; ◆＋◆＋▲＋●＋●＋●＝ {C}. What number does ● stand for?

solution.en: Divide the 2nd equation by 2: ▲＋●＝{B/2}. From the 1st, ◆＝{A}−{B/2}＝{d}. Put into the 3rd: ▲＋3●＝{C}−2×{d}＝{C-2*d}; subtract ▲＋●＝{B/2} to get 2●＝{C-2*d-B/2}, so ●＝{c}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 移动最少的猪使每个圈一样多

stem.en: Farmer Joe has 4 pens (see original picture); pigs may only be moved through the gates in the direction of the arrows. He wants every pen to have the same number of pigs. What is the FEWEST pigs he must move?
stem.zh: 农夫乔有 4 个猪圈（见原题图），猪只能按图中箭头的方向赶过门。他想让每个猪圈的猪一样多，最少要移动几头猪？

solution.en: Count the pigs in each pen, find the average, then move pigs from fuller pens to emptier ones only along the allowed arrow directions; the fewest moves needed is 7.
solution.zh: 先数出四个圈的猪，算出平均数，再沿着箭头允许的方向把多的圈里的猪补到少的圈里，最少要移动 7 头。
